def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize text labels (strip spaces, unify case)
    for c in ['penguin_id', 'species', 'island', 'sex']:
        df[c] = df[c].astype('string').str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.capitalize()
    # coerce numeric columns written as text
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    # fix out-of-range body mass (e.g. 3650000 -> 3650 g)
    bad = (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500) | (df['body_mass_g'] < 2500)
    df.loc[bad, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[bad, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df


def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = d.groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
